name: jabar
description: Java language support for Bazel megarepos, backed by SCIP indexes

jabar.server.path.description: Path to the jabar binary. Leave empty to look for target/release/jabar (then debug) near the extension or the open workspace, and fall back to `jabar` on PATH.

jabar.trace.server.description: Log the LSP traffic between VS Code and jabar.

jabar.server.log.description: Value for JABAR_LOG in the server process, e.g. `jabar_server=debug`.

jabar.bazel.description: Bazel executable used when Jabar builds an index.

jabar.outputBase.description: Optional dedicated Bazel output base for Jabar indexing.

jabar.index.auto.description: Run Jabar's bundled scip-java aspect when no SCIP shards exist.

jabar.index.targets.description: Bazel target patterns indexed when automatic indexing is enabled.

jabar.index.scipJava.description: Path to the separately installed scip-java binary. Leave empty to use PATH.

jabar.javaHome.description: JAVA_HOME passed to Jabar for automatic scip-java indexing. Leave empty to inherit the environment.
